name: Neutrino-4
notes: No official Neutrino-4 website was found; none recorded.

The reported oscillation signal was challenged by PROSPECT, whose final analysis (PRL 134, 151802) states that the Neutrino-4 best-fit point is ruled out at more than five standard deviations; that is PROSPECT's statement, not a retraction by Neutrino-4.

physics_goals.quote: We present the results of the Neutrino-4 experiment on search for a sterile neutrino.
physics_goals.value: Search for a sterile neutrino through the dependence of the reactor antineutrino flux and spectrum on distance (6-12 m) from the core of a compact highly enriched uranium reactor

summary.plain: A movable detector on rails beside a compact research reactor in Dimitrovgrad, Russia, used to look for a hypothetical sterile neutrino. Its team reported an oscillation signal of about three standard deviations, which other experiments, including PROSPECT, later disfavoured.
summary.technical: Reactor antineutrino experiment at the SM-3 reactor (90 MW_th, highly enriched 235U, 42 x 42 x 35 cm^3 core): a 1.8 m^3 Gd-doped (0.1 %) liquid-scintillator detector in 50 sections, moved between 6 and 12 m from the core. Model-independent coherent-sum analysis claims an oscillation effect near delta m^2_14 ~ 7.3 eV^2, sin^2(2 theta_14) ~ 0.26-0.38 (2.9-3.5 sigma).
